doc.title: Just Today

listing.title: ADHD Planner 2027 Digital, Goodnotes Planner for iPad and Android, Daily Weekly Monthly, Time Blocking, Starts Oct 2026, Hyperlinked
listing.description:
Just Today is a dated 2027 ADHD digital planner for adults who have bought pretty planners before and stopped using them. One calm page a day, every date linked, and it starts on Monday, October 26, 2026 so you can begin this week instead of waiting for January.

What's inside: 541 pages in one landscape PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section and month on one screen
- Start here: 4 short steps to get going
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device
- 2027 year at a glance (every date opens its day)
- 12 month pages with One goal this month
- 12 habit trackers, one for each month
- 53 week pages with This week's top 3, Weekly reset and Not this week
- 365 day pages
- Head start from Monday, October 26, 2026 to December 31: 2 month pages, 9 week pages and 67 day pages (the Dec 28 week is Week 1 of 2027)
- Fell off? Start again page
- Dopamine menu
- Routines: morning, leaving the house, evening wind-down
- Energy map for the whole year
- 4 brain dump pages and 8 notes pages

Good to know: landscape only. Weeks start on Monday. No stickers. It is not a fillable form: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool.

What makes it different
- Working in five minutes. The cover's Open planner button takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work on your device before you plan anything. If a button does nothing, the fix list is right on that page.
- The same seven boxes every day: Today's top 3, Time blocks from 7am to 9pm, Brain dump, Energy 1 to 5 with Basics (meds or vitamins, water, a real meal), One win today and Dopamine break. One page to learn, and half of it is open space to write.
- A no-guilt way back. Missed a week? The Restart page says skip the gap, jump to today in two taps and write one thing. No catching up.
- Easy to get around. Month tabs run down the right edge of every page. A top bar takes you Home, to the Year, Restart, Dopamine, Energy, Brain dump and Notes. A Month / Week trail works as a back button, and day pages have previous and next arrows.
- Short on purpose. Not 50 templates, just the pages you will use every day.
- Start now. Pages from Monday, October 26, 2026 lead straight into January 2027.
- Calm to look at: warm cream paper, dark ink and soft teal, with text that stays crisp at any zoom.
- Help inside the file. The instructions are printed on the pages, not only in a video.

Works with
Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android tablets and Windows tablets. You need a PDF planner app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages.
Not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or Google Drive preview.
Links not tapping? Turn the pen off to follow a link and back on to write.

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your planner app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then tap Year and today's date (between October 26 and December 31, 2026, tap Head start on the Year page). Fill Today's top 3. That is the whole job for today.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF planner app: Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Noteshelf. Files, Photos and Drive preview can't follow links.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes.
- Is there a portrait version? Not yet. This planner is landscape only.

What you get
- Just-Today.pdf (18.4 MB, 541 pages, landscape)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
Message us on Etsy and we'll help you set it up.

evidence.positioning: For adults with ADHD who have bought pretty planners before and stopped using them: a dated 2027 planner for Goodnotes, Notability and Android tablets that starts with a Nov to Dec 2026 head start, works in the first five minutes (Start here page plus a Setup check page), keeps every day to one calm page, and has a no-guilt Restart page for coming back. Top sellers compete on how much is inside, while their buyers' biggest complaints are that they could not get it working or it was too much, so this one wins on working first time and being easy to return to.

checks.closest: 2026 Digital Planner | GoodNotes Planner & Notability Planner for iPad | Minimalist Daily Weekly Monthly Planner for Productivity

visual.issue: 2026 buyers can land in 2027. The NOV and DEC tabs open November and December 2027 from all 21 non-calendar pages (Contents, Start here, Setup check, Year, Restart, Dopamine, Routines, Energy, Brain dump, Notes), and Contents even says 'or a month tab on the right'. A November 2026 buyer who taps NOV from the Brain dump or Contents writes in November 2027. Only head-start pages point NOV/DEC to 2026.
visual.where: index, start, linktest, year, restart, dopamine, routines, energy, dump-dump4, notes-notes8 (rail)

visual.issue: An October buyer's day-one page is confusing. Step 4 (Year > Head start) lands on a page titled 'November'. October 26-31 sit in its first row in full ink with no 'Oct' label, so the page shows two 27s (Oct 27 in row 1, Nov 27 in row 5). Only the small 'Oct 26' week chip says October. Fix: label the cells 'Oct 26'-'Oct 31' or grey-tag the row 'OCT'.
visual.where: hs11; start step 4; year Head start button

visual.issue: Photo 9, which sells the head start (the main reason to buy in Oct-Dec), puts three pages in a row. Only the titles are readable at listing size, and about 45% of the canvas (above and below the tablets) is empty (r005: 2x2 or two larger pages).

The year boundary still breaks the flow. Head-start Week 9 has no next arrow; its 'Continue to January 2027' button opens the January month page, not Week 1. Its back arrow floats mid-header (about x=640) instead of at the right edge. Week 1 has no back arrow. Swiping goes Dec 28-31 day pages, then January, January habits, then Week 1 (r008: Week 1's Thursday is Dec 31 2026). The listing does disclose that the Dec 28 week is Week 1.

Rough edges in the head start. On the Oct 26-31 day pages the trail says 'October 2026' but opens the page titled November, no tab is highlighted, and OCT opens October 2027. Head-start months say 'Goals' where 2027 months say 'One goal this month'.

The start date copy is inconsistent. The description says 'begin this week', but a buyer on Oct 21-25 (the listing is dated Oct 21) has no page for this week, and Start here step 4 covers only Oct 26-Dec 31 2026 and 2027. Photo 10 says 'Nov and Dec 2026 included' while the file starts Oct 26. Its alt text promises 'head start from October 26, 2026', which the photo doesn't say.

Photo 7's copy says 'Plus morning, leaving and evening routines', but the Routines page isn't in the photo (r005). Photo 1's rear tablet (the January 11 day page) has no caption; only the cover is captioned.

Half-empty areas (r006). Contents has an empty 12th card slot and a blank band of about 110pt above 'How the links work'. Setup check's left column is empty for about 135pt below the fix list; a 'come back here' link would fit there. The energy map's right column is empty below the color key for about two thirds of its height. Dopamine columns end in about 95pt of empty box, Routines in about 55pt.
Near a service promise (r007): 'Still stuck? Message us on Etsy and we will help' (Setup check) and 'Message us on Etsy and we'll help you set it up' (listing). Better to say what the buyer can do.
The Setup check buttons jump but never come back. The target pages have no return link, so the buyer must remember 'Home, then Setup check' (2 taps).
On the Start here top-bar map, 'NOTES / Notes' repeats itself, and 'YEAR / Calendar' and 'ENERGY / Track' say little.

Mid-year friction. Week numbers run one ahead of ISO all year (Week 1 = Dec 28-Jan 3, 53 weeks), so a March 2027 buyer sees different numbers than their phone or work calendar. The Contents 'Habit trackers' card always opens January.
visual.where: w01-w53, month week chips, day trails; index Habit trackers card > m01h

visual.issue: Brain dump and Notes pages only have a forward arrow (page 4 of 4 and 8 of 8 have none). There is no way to go back one page; the top bar returns to page 1.
On Year at a glance, row spacing varies by month: February's 4 rows are stretched next to January's 5, so dates in the same band sit at uneven heights.
On day pages, the Energy 1 to 5 box is about 60% empty under one row of circles, and One win today and Dopamine break have one line each. The bottom row looks sparse next to the dense time blocks.

The 6px coral strip sits flush with the top edge just left of the tab rail. At page size it reads like a clipped tab or render glitch, not an accent. The cover is pale teal, not the cream paper the look spec names.

complaints.theme: Hard to use day to day
complaints.how: Every day page has the same seven boxes in the same places (Today's top 3, Time blocks 7am to 9pm, Brain dump, Energy 1 to 5 with Basics, One win today, Dopamine break), so there is one page to learn. The cover's Open planner button lands on the 4-step Start here page, and every page carries Home, the month tabs and a Month / Week breadcrumb.
complaints.quote: Worst download ever, save your money.  Hard to download and impossible to use.

complaints.theme: Couldn't download or open the file
complaints.how: Listing copy and photo 4 give the download in 3 steps: buy, download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files), open the PDF in a planner app. It ships as one PDF, not a zip, under 19.5 MB so it downloads and imports quickly. The Start here page repeats the steps for anyone who opened it on a computer first.
complaints.quote: Worst download ever, save your money.  Hard to download and impossible to use.

complaints.how: Every listing photo is a screenshot of the built file, captioned with the page name; no mockup shows anything the file lacks. The description lists each page type with counts and says plainly: landscape only, Monday-start weeks, Nov to Dec 2026 has month and week pages (no day pages), no stickers, handwrite or use the app's text tool (not a fillable form). Photo 10 repeats this next to the Contents page.
complaints.quote: Ich habe es gekauft, weil es in der Beschreibung hiess, das hochkant möglich ist, doch weder in Goodnotes, noch in Notability funktioniert hochkant!

complaints.theme: Doesn't work on my app or device
complaints.how: Pages are 1024 x 768 landscape (4:3, the iPad's own shape) so there are no big empty margins, and all tabs and dates are plain PDF links. The listing has a Works with / Not for box: works in Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets; not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or Google Drive preview. The Setup check page proves it on the buyer's own device in one minute.
complaints.quote: Unable to use on a Samsung tablet S.  Seller tried to help, but after doing research, it's not compatible with this style tablet.

complaints.how: Month tabs run down the right edge of every page (answering 'there are no monthly tabs so you are swiping through the pages'), and year, month, week and day pages are all linked to each other. It is dated, so there is nothing to set up: open today and write. The Contents page shows every section and month on one screen.
complaints.quote: Just wasn’t a very impressive or practical item.

complaints.how: Start here (4 numbered steps: open it in a planner app, check the links, pen off to tap and on to write, plan one day) and Setup check are the first two cards on the Contents page and the pages right after it. 'Where are the stickers?' cannot happen: there are none, and the listing says so.
complaints.quote: I was not sure how to edit this file I followed the instructions and it still didn’t turn out right.

complaints.how: Pages run in strict date order: Nov to Dec 2026 head start, then each 2027 month followed by its weeks and their days, and each week and day page appears exactly once (the line currently prints the 8 weeks that span two months twice; see build_notes). The build checks 0 broken links and no overflowing text, and all text is vector so it stays crisp at any zoom.
complaints.quote: This product was very hard to use and I couldn't download it to use on my iPad or computer with having issues seeing part of the planning pages.

complaints.how: Most support messages are 'it does not work' questions, so the answers are in the file and the listing: the Setup check page's 'Nothing happened?' list (pen off, open in a planner app, import as PDF, then message us), the Start here steps, and a listing FAQ with the top five problems (Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, how to type, landscape only). How fast the shop replies is shop-level (Darren's Etsy inbox), not something the file can fix.
complaints.quote: How to download too many apps just to make their main app work plus it took days for their customer service to reach back

complaints.how: Priced at $14, well under the $22 median, for a full dated 2027 with day pages plus a 2026 head start. Writing space, the thing a $14 buyer said was missing, is generous: half of each day page is open writing (brain dump, time blocks), each weekday gets its own lined box on the week page, and text is set at 1.1 scale. Photo 2 shows a day page at real size so buyers can judge the space before buying.
complaints.quote: I did not feel the spacing for writing in the calendar was sufficient for my needs.  Sucks wasted $14 and I have already deleted.

complaints.theme: Hard to navigate or find pages
complaints.how: Three ways to move on every month, week and day page: month tabs down the right edge, a top bar (Home, Year, Restart, Dopamine, Energy, Brain dump, Notes), and a breadcrumb (January / Week 3) that works as a back button. Day pages add previous and next arrows, every date on the year page jumps to its day, and the Contents page links every section and month.
complaints.quote: It’s very difficult to navigate, too many options but not satisfied with the after import navigation.

complaints.how: Short on purpose: nine page types (year, month, habit tracker, week, day, dopamine menu, routines, energy map, brain dump and notes) instead of dozens of templates, seven boxes per day page, and a Contents page that fits on one screen. Start here says 'plan one day' and the Restart page says 'do not catch up'. The listing says: not 50 templates, just the pages you will use every day.
complaints.quote: It was overwhelming, I sat and tried to read through as much of it as possible, but I had no idea where to start.

complaints.how: The Start here page says how to write and type: pen on to write, pen off to tap links, the app's text tool to type. Anything personal is left blank to fill in (habit names, the month's one goal, about half of each dopamine menu and routine column), so buyers customize by writing, not by editing the PDF. The listing says it is not a fillable form.
complaints.quote: I was not sure how to edit this file I followed the instructions and it still didn’t turn out right.

complaints.how: The Setup check page has three buttons (a month, the year, Contents) that jump and come back, plus the 'Nothing happened?' fix list. Every link in the file is checked at build (0 broken links allowed).

standard.name: Dated for the year
standard.how: Dated 2027, Monday-start, every date linked: year page to month, month to its weeks, week to each day, day to the next and previous day.

standard.name: Covers more than one year
standard.how: Covers two years: Nov and Dec 2026 head-start month and week pages before the full 2027 year (14 months in all), so a buyer in late October can start this week instead of waiting for January.

standard.name: Says Goodnotes
standard.how: One landscape PDF that works in Goodnotes (named first in title and listing), Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets.

unique.name: Five-minute start and setup check
unique.what: Page 3 is a 4-step Start here guide and page 4 is a Setup check page with buttons that jump and return, plus a fix list if they do not. The cover's Open planner button lands on Start here.
unique.why: The biggest complaint cluster is buyers who could not get the file working: hard to use (42), could not download or open (41), wrong device or app (22), confusing setup (19), does not work (10). No top seller shows a quick start or a link test in their titles.

unique.name: One calm ADHD day page
unique.what: The same seven boxes every day: Today's top 3, Time blocks 7am to 9pm, Brain dump, Energy 1 to 5 with Basics (meds, water, a real meal), One win today and Dopamine break. The week page mirrors it with This week's top 3, a Weekly reset and Not this week.
unique.why: Time blocking and a top-3 priority list are not seen in any top seller's title and brain dump pages appear in 3%, yet overwhelm and 'no idea where to start' are recurring complaints. A fixed short layout answers both.

unique.name: Fell off? Start again page
unique.what: A one-page, no-guilt way back in, in the top bar as Restart: skip the gap and do not catch up, jump to today in two taps, write one thing in Today's top 3, empty your head into the brain dump. Its tip points to the weekly reset for longer breaks.
unique.why: Overwhelmed buyers say they had 'no idea where to start', and buyers who could not keep up called the planner not useful. Missed weeks are the normal ADHD planner failure; giving people a door back in keeps them using it, which drives the 'I use it every day' and repeat-buyer praise.

unique.name: Dopamine menu and routines
unique.what: A Dopamine menu page (Quick 5 min, Medium 20 min, Big rewards, Costs you later) and a Routines page (Morning, Leaving the house, Evening wind-down), each column part pre-filled and part blank to make your own. The day page's Dopamine break box is where you note the one you picked.
unique.why: Dopamine menus and routine builders are not seen in any top seller's title, and buyers ask for more ways to customize. Both are single pages, so they add tools without adding overwhelm.
